topic: Remove dried blood stains from fabric
core_question: How do I get a dried blood stain out of fabric? (secondary: How do you fix a soccer ball that has a puncture and won't stay inflated?)
answer_summary: Soak in cold water (never hot, which sets the stain), apply hydrogen peroxide or an enzyme cleaner directly, gently rub, and rinse repeatedly before washing normally.; after the topic shift: Find the leak (often near the valve or a seam) by inflating and submerging the ball in water, then apply a specialized rubber cement patch or injectable sealant to seal the bladder before reinflating.
persona: impatient and curt; writing terse one-liners
